description: This file defines a generic class 'Range<T>' that models a contiguous range with start and end points, including equality and hash code implementations, and a constructor that enforces the range validity.

classes.name: Range<T>
classes.description: A generic class representing a contiguous range with start and end points, supporting equality checks and hash code generation.

methods.name: Range
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the range with start and end points, optionally using a custom comparer, and throws an exception if the range is invalid.

methods.name: Equals(object obj)
methods.description: Overrides Object.Equals to compare with another object, returning true if it is a Range<T> with the same start and end.

methods.name: Equals(Range<T> other)
methods.description: Checks equality with another Range<T> based on start and end points.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on start and end points, using default equality comparer for type T.
